input.module_under_test: Review Service: Implements a two-level review workflow for submitted content. Each content must receive both a brand review and a compliance review before being approved. Brand reviews can only be submitted by the campaign owner; compliance reviews require admin role. Review decisions are: approved, rejected, or revision_requested (pending is not allowed as a submission decision). Duplicate reviews of the same type for the same content are prevented. After each review submission, content status is automatically updated: rejection sets content to rejected, revision_requested sets content to revision_requested with notes, and dual approval (both brand + compliance approved) sets content to approved. Single approval alone does not change content status.
input.existing_test_patterns: Tests use pytest-asyncio with an httpx AsyncClient hitting the FastAPI app. Fixtures build a full dependency chain: review_campaign -> review_application -> submitted_content. Review submission uses POST to /api/v1/contents/{id}/reviews with JSON body containing review_type, decision, and optional comments. Multi-step tests (dual approval flow) chain multiple API calls and verify final content status via a separate GET. Assertions check HTTP status codes, JSON body fields, and error message substrings. Tests are grouped by section: Brand Review, Compliance Review, Dual Approval Flow, Edge Cases, List Reviews.

edge_cases_covered: Brand approve success with decided_at timestamp
Brand reject content sets decision to rejected
Brand request revision sets decision to revision_requested
Content approved only after both brand AND compliance approvals
Content stays submitted after only brand approval (single review insufficient)
Duplicate review type for same content returns 422 with 'already exists'
List reviews returns both brand and compliance reviews
List reviews for content with no reviews returns empty array

required_edge_cases: Role validation: brand_review requires campaign ownership
Role validation: compliance review requires admin role
Duplicate active review of same type is prevented
Content approved only after dual approval (brand + compliance)
Single approval does not change content status
Only submitted content can be reviewed
